layers.name: XodOS picks
layers.note: First-party layer: hand-picked entries, agent-ready surfaces verified from the shipped manifest.

layers.name: XodOS Official shelf
layers.note: First-party XodOS suite apps (Files, Mail, Docs, Calendar, Contacts, Photos, Notes, anchored on rdrive), built agent-first under the Agent-First Contract in docs/SUITE.md. Suite entries carry official: true and origin suite; their agentCapabilities are the human-readable projection of the agent-manifest.json shipped in their APK. The OS image ships them (the floor); the Store delivers updates and completion.

layers.name: Fleet — agent tools
layers.note: The Internet of Things fleet: open-source agent tools that run on the person's R Network host, never on the phone. Seeded 2026-11-07 from the publish train's verified records (publish/train-results.json COMPLETE units, shipcheck GO) plus Greenlight, read back from the live MCP Registry. Only verified-published tools are listed; the shelf grows as the publishing train works its queue.

layers.name: Web apps
layers.note: Proprietary services enter the store ONLY as web entries: a name, a URL, an honest label. No APK is ever listed, preloaded, bundled, or redistributed for them, and no proprietary logos or artwork ship. The action is OPEN in the browser, never install.

layers.name: Emulators
layers.note: Console emulators, byte-verified from their official channels (F-Droid builds + PPSSPP's official site build) and marked category: emulator with the systems each plays. XodOS bundles NO emulators and NO games/ROMs — the catalog lists the emulators themselves only; the Emulators surface in the OS downloads them through the same verified staged-install path as every app, and prepares /sdcard/XodOS/Emulation/roms/<system> for the user's own game files. Sources that offer no official direct APK (DuckStation, Redream, Mupen64Plus FZ, the Pizza Boy set, My Boy!/My OldBoy!) and unofficial patch distributions (AetherSX2/NetherSX2) are excluded by the same verify-or-leave-out rule.

layers.name: F-Droid open shelf
layers.note: v1.1: the full F-Droid repository, ingested from its signed index (index-v1.jar, repo cert sha256 43238D512C1E5EB2D6569F4A3AFBF5523418B82E0A3ED1552770ABB9A9C9CCAB). Entries merge into the same list; a curated entry wins over the fdroid entry for the same package; fdroid entries carry no agent-ready flags until verified into the curated layer.
